title: epiphorella elastica
intro: Epiphorella elastica, commonly known as the "stink ant tree," is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Epiphorella elastica include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
